zoe.marketing: Quick sync idea 9: Launch a tiny OSS refkit + 3 snack tutorials + a short benchmark we can reproduce. Goals: GitHub traction, signups, webinar signups.

sam.devrel: Yes. Tutorials: Quickstart (10m), Latency tuning (12m), Add new model (15m). Provide copy-paste snippets and Docker dev image.

eli.eng: I'll run a compact perf harness on g6/g5. fp16 vs int4, seq=128, batch=1/4. ETA 24h. sdrbot: perf job scheduled at 03:10 UTC.

ana.content: I'll draft the blog + two tweet threads (launch and dev thread). Need bench CSV + one eng quote.

ryan.growth: For inbound: gated download + two flows: enterprise -> SDR queue, OSS contributors -> devrel nurture. Routing pseudocode: 
if paying_customer: acct-exec
elif company_size >= 50 or monthly_tokens >= 100000: sdr
elif github_contrib == true: devrel_nurture
else: marketing_drip

zoe.marketing: Messaging variants: A) "Refkit Mini: ship LLM features fast" B) "Bench-backed starter for predictable inference" We'll A/B test hero.

sam.devrel: Add a tiny eval notebook so users can reproduce bench numbers locally. Also include CONTRIBUTING.md.

eli.eng: Bench done. Early numbers: g6 int4 batch1 -> ~2.0x tokens/sec vs fp16. Uploading CSV + runbook to repo.

ana.content: Got it. Draft post will be transparent about model, seq length, batch, and region. Tone: developer-first.

ryan.growth: Add an email drip variant for maintainers highlighting contribution perks.

zoe.marketing: Action items: eli -> artifacts (24h), sam -> tutorials + quick videos (5d), ana -> post + social (48h), ryan -> landing + routing (48h). Sync in 24h to lock dates. :rocket:
